Hi all,

We’d like to invite you to a call on Monday, 8 September at 15:00 UTC, where the [QMDB](https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/qmdb) team will present their database design and open the floor for questions from EL devs.

Call info: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1711
